predictions.headline: Islanders' goaltending and defence make them a clear home favourite
predictions.text: New York Islanders to win the moneyline against the Los Angeles Kings at UBS Arena. The Islanders are 5-3-1 and have conceded only 19 goals in nine games, a 2.11 goals-against average, while scoring 27. Los Angeles have played just seven games, going 1-4-2, and have shipped 27 goals at 3.86 per game while scoring 17. Bo Horvat leads New York with five goals, Matthew Schaefer has eight assists and Ilya Sorokin has five wins; the Kings' leading scorer is Artemi Panarin with four. The model makes the Islanders a 71.2% favourite, the highest NHL probability on this slate.

facts.claim: NY Islanders 5-3-1, 27 goals for, 19 against in 9 games
Los Angeles 1-4-2 in 7 games, 17 for, 27 against
Horvat 5 goals, Schaefer 8 assists, Sorokin 5 wins, Panarin 4 goals

predictions.headline: PSG's scoring power should tell in Zagreb
predictions.text: Paris Saint-Germain to win the match-winner market away at HC Zagreb on 21 October. PSG are 3-1-0 in Group C and have scored 154 goals in four games, the highest total in the group phase, while conceding 128. Zagreb are 1-0-3 with 117 scored and 130 conceded and have won only one of their four group matches. The model makes PSG a 70.2% favourite, which earns a high-confidence grade.

PSG's 154 goals is the highest total in the group phase before round 5
Zagreb are 1-0-3 with 117 goals scored and 130 conceded (2 points)
Zagreb host PSG at Arena Zagreb on 21 October, throw-off 18:45 CEST
